# NXT

> NXT is a mobile digital wallet app. It lets you send money to people nearby
> using your phone's location or by scanning a QR code, split bills and track
> who has paid, top up your account or share a top-up link, and check your
> balance from the login screen without signing in. NXT also issues Visa and
> Mastercard credit cards.

Contact: connect@mynxt.com

## App features

- **Transfer by Location** — send money in seconds to any NXT user nearby using the phone's location, with no account numbers. Transfers can be tracked and actioned from "My Bag".
- **Transfer via QR** — scan a recipient's QR code and send money without cash or card.
- **Top-up** — top up your account in seconds, or share a link so someone else can top you up.
- **Bill Split** — split bills with friends, send instant requests and track payments.
- **Quick Balance** — check your preferred accounts from the login screen by drag and drop, without logging in.

## Credit cards

- **Visa Platinum Euro** — access to over 25 airport lounges, medical and travel assistance, extended warranty on purchases, purchase protection for up to 12 months, discounts through visamiddleeast.com, global emergency assistance.
- **Mastercard Titanium** — access to over 10 airport lounges, benefits with Booking.com, IHG Hotels & Resorts and selected travel partners, dining and lifestyle experiences through Priceless.com, international car rental offers.
- **Visa Infinite** — access to over 1,300 airport lounges, concierge service, dedicated relationship manager, travel insurance, extended warranty, purchase protection for up to 12 months, fraudulent card misuse protection, global emergency assistance.
- **Visa LBP** — worldwide Visa acceptance, contactless payments, real-time spend notifications, 24/7 fraud protection.
